[Denied] I'm sorry but your map has been denied for the following reasons..
Lack of effort - Some parts of the map, namely the middle lanes, appear to have not much effort put into them, as a result, the map appears dull and rushed. 
Furthermore, the map shows no noticeable signs that make it stand out as a map.
It appears to not have good pvp space.
The map is also unnatural, try using a smooth broth.

Finally, I'd like to address how you are taking your screenshots.
Please use..
-Normal FOV
-F1 Enabled
-Default Texture pack

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Stop biting on him for hacks, it's no issue..... I used hacks plenty and openly when making maps because it helped the build process a lot. I could fly faster, break and place faster, have some useful client commands and tools, and quite a few other features. I even had screenshots with the hacks activated back in old avicus on map releases, I only stopped because senior staff said it was a bad example.

But what Zedther stand we stand by. Thaks for the submission though.
